```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(here)
library(caret)
library(readxl)
library(ggfortify)
library(GGally)
library(glmnet)
library(Hmisc)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
# Install thematic and un-comment for themed static plots (i.e., ggplot2)
# thematic::thematic_rmd()
```


```{r include=FALSE}
db <- read_excel(here("data/dataform.xlsx"))
db <- na.omit(db)

db$ID <- as.factor(db$ID) 
db$Group <- as.factor(db$Group) 



db <- db %>%
  select(-c("MitoCount", "TotArea", "Bcount", "TotPerim", "TotBLength", "Bjunct", "BEndP"))

long_db <- db %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(ID, Group), names_to = "Predictor", values_to = "Value")

```

```{r}

ggplotly(bx)
```

```{r}

  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#a39b9b",  "#67c7c5", "#f2de79")) +

ggplotly(dens)

```


Variables are intercorrelated

Variable Correlation
-------------------------------------
    

```{r}
var_cor <- db %>%
  select(-c(ID, Group)) %>%
  ggcorr(label = TRUE, low = "#5499C7", high = "#BE0461", size =3) 


ggplotly(var_cor)

vclus <- varclus(as.matrix(db[-c(1,2)]))


groups <- cutree(vclus$hclust, 3)

red_vars <- redun(as.matrix(db[-c(1,2)]))

db_res <- db %>%
  select(c("ID", "Group", red_vars$In))



```

Neural Network Multinomial Regression 
==========================================================================================================================


```{r include=FALSE}
set.seed(2024)

db_ml <- db_res 


trnIndex <- createDataPartition(db_ml$Group, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

trn <- db_ml[trnIndex,]
tst <- db_ml[-trnIndex,]

trn[-c(1,2)] <- scale(log2(trn[-c(1,2)]))
tst[-c(1,2)] <- scale(log2(tst[-c(1,2)]))

```

```{r include = FALSE}
set.seed(2024)

train_control <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv", number=10, repeats=3)


train_model <-  function(dat, method, search_grid=NULL) {
  set.seed(2024)
  
  mdl <- train(Group ~ .,
                  data = dat[-1], 
                  method = method,
                  tuneGrid = search_grid,
                  trControl = train_control,
                  trace = FALSE)
  
  return(mdl)
}
  


make_bound_plot <- function(mod, dat, pcx = 1, pcy = 2, alg) {

preproc <- preProcess(dat[-c(1,2)], method = c("pca"))

pca_transformed <- predict(preproc, dat[-c(1,2)])
pca_transformed <- data.frame(pca_transformed, Group = dat$Group)

colnames(pca_transformed)[pcx] <- "X"
colnames(pca_transformed)[pcy] <- "Y"

# Create a grid of points in the PCA-transformed space
x_min <- min(pca_transformed$X) - 1
x_max <- max(pca_transformed$X) + 1
y_min <- min(pca_transformed$Y) - 1
y_max <- max(pca_transformed$Y) + 1

# Generate grid points
grid <- expand.grid(X = seq(x_min, x_max, length.out = 100),
                    Y = seq(y_min, y_max, length.out = 100))


# Inverse transform the grid to the original feature space
inverse_pca <- function(pca_model, pca_data, original_data) {
  center <- pca_model$mean
  scale <- pca_model$std
  rotation <- pca_model$rotation
  
  # Calculate the original data matrix
  original_matrix <- as.matrix(pca_data) %*% t(rotation[, 1:ncol(pca_data)])
  
  # Re-scale and re-center
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, scale, `*`)
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, center, `+`)
  
  return(as.data.frame(original_matrix))
}

# Get the original feature names (excluding 'Group')
original_feature_names <- names(dat)[-c(1,2)]

# Perform inverse PCA transformation on the grid
grid_original <- inverse_pca(preproc, grid, dat[original_feature_names])
colnames(grid_original) <- original_feature_names

# Predict on the original feature space
grid_original$Group <- predict(mod, grid_original, type = "raw")


# Plot the decision boundary
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pca_transformed, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = Group), size = 2) +
  geom_tile(data = grid, aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = grid_original$Group), alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = paste(alg, "Decision Boundary with PCA"),
       x = paste("Principal Component", pcx),
       y = paste("Principal Component", pcy)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(labels = levels(pca_transformed$Group), values = c("#a39b9b",  "#67c7c5", "#f2de79")) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = levels(pca_transformed$Group), values = c("#a39b9b",  "#67c7c5", "#f2de79"))
}


```





```{r}
set.seed(2024)

search_grid <- expand.grid(
  decay = seq(0, 0.2, by = 0.01)
)


multi_model <- train_model(trn, "multinom", search_grid)




pred_multi_model <- data.frame(Prediction = predict(multi_model, newx = as.matrix(trn[-c(1,2)]), type="raw"))

trn_class_res <- data.frame(ID = trn$ID, Prediction = pred_multi_model, Reference = trn$Group)

cfm <- confusionMatrix(predict(multi_model), trn$Group, positive = "DNML1")




```


Plot
-------------------------------------

```{r}
make_bound_plot(multi_model, trn, 1, 2, "Neural Network")

```
